neighbours.label: A space token standing on its own: the space typed right before digits ('in 1774', 'gate 9', 'about 40 people') or an extra doubled space between two words; weaker on the spaces that indent a code line. Quiet: spelled-out numbers ('forty'), digits with no space before them ($40, B12, a number opening a new line) and ordinary single spaces before words.
neighbours.short: lone space token (before digits, doubled space)

notes: Sentences written blind by a second author who saw only the label (blind:claude-opus-5-5 label-only). Bonsai is causal, so the lone ' ' token's activation cannot depend on what follows it: 'some  crabs' (doubled space) and 'some urchins' (a rare word the tokenizer splits off its space) read identically. Solver (DE) found no leak; near-miss ceiling 0.28 was a code-indent line.
